text.tspan: 5 V rail → harness J2.1, strip, U3
J2 (downstream, 5-pin JST-SH): 1 VCC 5 V · 2 GND · 3 DATA in · 4 CLK · 5 /PL — one SPI transaction reads 16·N bits (HW-4: ≤8 modules).
Single-point ground tie to machine lamp return (HW-6). Strip power sized separately (~60 mA/LED white), never from U2.
